sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:105

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:105:1
items.html: The three Eheyehs of Yudin, Alfin, Hehin, and they are in her three lower ones, and this lower one is in the filling of Hehin: Meaning, the Eheyeh of Hehin is in her three lower ones, and he explained the other two Eheyehs above: that the Eheyeh of Yudin is in her GAR [first three], and the Eheyeh of Alfin is in her HGT. As above, Part 11, item 114.

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 12:105:2
items.html: At the injection of the drop of redness they ascend upward in the first Eheyeh of Yudin, etc.; and likewise the first Eheyeh of Yudin descends and clothes in the second Eheyeh of Alfin. Meaning, that at the injection of the drop for the secret of the Ibur, AVI were clothed in their outer vessels, namely in the discernment of the coarseness of the root, which is the coarseness of Keter, that brings out the level of NHY in the light of Nefesh. Therefore it is reckoned that the two lower Eheyehs, which are of Hehin and Alfin, namely NHY and HGT, rose to the Eheyeh of Yudin, which is the discernment of her KHBD, whose meaning is Rosh and Keter — for they coupled only upon the coarseness of Keter. However here, where the coupling is for the sake of the level of Ruach of ZA, then AVI need to be clothed in their middle vessels, where is the discernment of the coarseness of phase one, which brings out the level of HGT; therefore the Eheyeh of Yudin, and likewise the Eheyeh of Hehin, need to rise to the Eheyeh of Alfin, which is the discernment of the HGT of AVI, namely their middle vessels, where is the discernment of the coarseness of phase one, as above — in such a way that the coupling is made in the discernment of the Eheyeh of Alfin.
